cohort: The participants were 120 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
finding: Nalbuphine and dexmedetomidine significantly reduced the time to cessation of shivering, increased treatment success rates, and improved alertness/sedation scores compared to saline in women after cesarean section, with nalbuphine 0.07 mg/kg being safe and effective.
